target: 國立臺灣大學溪頭銀杏橋（2017竣工版本）
scope: Independent complete exterior visual approximation review against official completed-project plan/elevation and photographs. Not engineering, survey, present-condition or print certification. No model geometry edited.

per_view_review.previews/front.png: Whole bridge and both abutments visible; continuous two-crest central-sag deck, two RC piers, paired side fan frames and transparent spaces beneath; revised compact rib footprint is consistent with 2017 elevation.
per_view_review.previews/rear.png: Opposite side confirms paired frames, opposite-side rail rhythm and both ends; overlap of rear fan does not imply a fifth rib.
per_view_review.previews/elevation.png: Four main ribs per near fan remain distinct above the foot, with shortened endpoints matching approximate source x207/240/267/290; short upper links do not originate at the foot. Two crests and central valley preserved, no flat or single-arch substitute.
per_view_review.previews/top.png: Main bridge is straight in plan with continuous narrow deck; left approach alone turns, right approach remains straight. This view does not independently expose lower fan ribs.
per_view_review.previews/left_oblique.png: Both pier-width pairs, foot plates, exposed underdeck members and actual open fan sectors visible; limited left turning stair approach is present and disclosed as approximate.

confirmed_features: Entire 36m main bridge with 8+20+8m nominal spans, not central-span crop or annual university-pond bamboo bridge.
Two cross-width RC piers, four side fan frames total, four principal ribs per fan; no added fifth from rear projection.
Different curved/near-straight fan members and small upper secondary ties; fan sectors and underbridge spaces not filled.
Continuous double-crest central-sag deck, side beams and rails, straight plan.
Rail panels have both fan patterns and changing diagonal direction rather than all one-direction bars.
Two abutments, short landings, left turned stair approach, underside members and visible steel/wood/RC distinction.
2014 angular 40m proposal excluded; official2017 36m curved plan prioritized with conflicting later40m statement disclosed.
resolved_preliminary_issue: Initial fan ribs extended too far toward the central valley. Final endpoints[-101,-79,-62,-47]mm relative to global model coordinates replace earlier overextended fan. Source pixel positions were independently rechecked with reviewer; accepted as approximate, not measured dimensions.
limitations: Only official bridge length/width/span values underlie nominal1:120; heights, curves, rib sections, connectors and exposed abutment dimensions remain approximate.
Source plan read at738px; rib endpoint coordinate ranges are image-reading estimates with several-pixel uncertainty, not survey coordinates.
Thirty rail panels per side, board/bolt counts, two upper links and detailed tie/brace layout are simplified representation, not independently verified exact counts.
35-degree six-step left approach and landing/abutment exposed heights are schematic; rectangular base is an added display/print connection, not creek terrain or actual foundation.
Buried combined foundations, riverbed, forest, people and temporary construction net/hoses omitted; exposed structures must not be interpreted as complete civil foundations.
2017-05-28 opening, earlyApril civil completion,2018 page URL and2024 lecture publication are distinct; source photos have no usable EXIF shooting dates; no2026 existing-condition claim.

Raw topology/local checks were performed by builder; this source review does not certify those numerics, real load capacity or printability. Thin rails and long spans remain risky; no actual print or support-free claim.
recommendation: Accept this hash-bound complete exterior approximation with documented limitations retained. Any geometry or preview change requires new image review and artifact hashes.
